rows.role_title: President of the Pan Africanist Congress of Azania
rows.text: The judgment records that under the order of the court "handed down on 20 April 2016" "the Electoral Commission was directed to communicate with Mr Luthando Mpinda and Mr Narius Moloto as representatives of the Pan Africanist Congress of Azania (PAC)" for the local government elections.

rows.role_title: President of the Pan Africanist Congress of Azania
rows.text: The judgment says that the effect of the Full Court's judgment "is that the PAC's decision in May 2013 to expel Mr Mphahlele stands."

rows.role_title: President of the Pan Africanist Congress of Azania
rows.printed_range: judgment headed 21/6/2016, date of judgment 20 June 2016
rows.text: The judgment says "Mr Mphahlele continues to base his claim to the membership and presidency of the PAC" on obiter comments in earlier judgments.

rows.role_title: President of the Pan Africanist Congress of Azania
rows.text: The judgment records the Electoral Commission's decision under which it "suspended the allocation of funding to the PAC until such time as the leadership struggle within the PAC had been resolved", and says "The decision of the Electoral Commission was taken on 17 June 2015."

rows.role_title: President of the Pan Africanist Congress of Azania
rows.printed_range: judgment headed 21/6/2016, date of judgment 20 June 2016
rows.text: The court ordered: "The application by the first applicant. Mr Letlapa Mphahlele for leave to appeal is dismissed with costs", struck Mr Mphethi's application from the roll, and gave costs to "the Pan Africanist Congress of Azania as represented by Mr Luthando Mpinda".
